title: Tra2beta Enhances Cell Proliferation by Inducing the Expression of Transcription Factor SP1 in Cervical Cancer.
authors: Li, Mo Juan; Xiong, Dan; Wang, Shuai; Huang, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Tra2beta在宫颈癌中通过上调转录因子SP1促进细胞增殖，属于癌症机制与表达调控研究，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: In this study, the role and potential mechanism of transformer 2beta (Tra2beta) in cervical cancer were explored. METHODS: The transcriptional data of Tra2beta in patients with cervical cancer from Gene Expression Profiling Interactive Analysis (GEPIA) and cBioPortal databases were investigated. The functions of Tra2beta were evaluated by using Western blot, MTT, colony formation, Transwell assays, and nude mouse tumor formation experiments. Target genes regulated by Tra2beta were studied by RNA-seq. Subsequently, representative genes were selected for RT-qPCR, confocal immunofluorescence, Western blot, and rescue experiments to verify their regulatory relationship. RESULTS: The dysregulation of Tra2beta in cervical cancer samples was observed. Tra2beta overexpression in Siha and Hela cells enhanced cell viability and proliferation, whereas Tra2beta knockdown showed the opposite effect. Alteration of Tra2beta expression did not affect cell migration and invasion. Furthermore, tumor xenograft models verified that Tra2beta promoted cervical cancer growth. Mechanically, Tra2beta positively regulated the mRNA and protein level of SP1, which was critical for the proliferative capability of Tra2beta. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrated the important role of the Tra2beta/SP1 axis in the progression of cervical cancer in vitro and in vivo, which provides a comprehensive understanding of the pathogenesis of cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究探讨了 transformer 2beta（Tra2beta）在宫颈癌中的作用及潜在机制。方法：利用基因表达谱交互分析（GEPIA）和cBioPortal数据库，研究了宫颈癌患者中Tra2beta的转录数据。通过Western blot、MTT、集落形成、Transwell实验及裸鼠肿瘤形成实验评估了Tra2beta的功能。通过RNA-seq研究了Tra2beta调控的靶基因。随后，选取代表性基因进行RT-qPCR、共聚焦免疫荧光、Western blot及拯救实验，以验证其调控关系。结果：观察到宫颈癌样本中Tra2beta的失调。在Siha和Hela细胞中，Tra2beta过表达增强了细胞活力和增殖能力，而Tra2beta敲低则产生相反效果。Tra2beta表达的改变不影响细胞迁移和侵袭。此外，肿瘤异种移植模型证实Tra2beta促进了宫颈癌的生长。机制上，Tra2beta正向调控SP1的mRNA和蛋白水平，这对Tra2beta的增殖能力至关重要。结论：本研究证明了Tra2beta/SP1轴在体外和体内宫颈癌进展中的重要作用，为宫颈癌的发病机制提供了全面理解。
